stories.title: Vermoedelijke nieuwe sabotageactie op het spoor tussen Apeldoorn en Deventer

en.title: Suspected new sabotage incident on railway between Apeldoorn and Deventer
en.summary: Train traffic between Apeldoorn and Deventer was halted Tuesday evening following a suspected sabotage act, according to rail operator Prorail.

stories.title: Nieuwe buis gevonden op spoor in Gelderland, komende tijd verscherpt toezicht

en.title: New pipe found on railway in Gelderland, enhanced monitoring planned
en.summary: A pipe was discovered on the railway near Teuge in Gelderland on Tuesday evening, which ProRail believes represents another sabotage incident. Enhanced surveillance will be implemented along the tracks in coming days.

stories.title: Buis gevonden bij spoor Teuge, ProRail gaat uit van nieuwe sabotageactie

en.title: Pipe found at Teuge railway, ProRail assumes new sabotage incident
en.summary: A pipe was found on the railway at Teuge, which ProRail attributes to a new sabotage act.

stories.title: Rechter blokkeert naam Trump op Kennedy Center weer, gebouw per direct dicht

en.title: Judge blocks Trump name at Kennedy Center again, building closed immediately
en.summary: A federal court in Washington D.C. has again prohibited placing President Trump's name on the Kennedy Center's exterior or renaming its associated plaza. Following the ruling, the institution's board immediately closed the building citing safety concerns.

stories.title: FC Utrecht legt 18 stadionverboden op voor supporters die met vuurwerk en bekers gooiden in gestaakte wedstrijd

en.title: FC Utrecht imposes 18 stadium bans on supporters who threw fireworks and cups in abandoned match
en.summary: FC Utrecht identified eighteen supporters who misbehaved during a home match against Go Ahead Eagles and issued them stadium bans.

stories.title: Artiest Brandt neemt Ajax aan de hand in wedstrijd tegen Willem II (5-1)

en.title: Artist Brandt leads Ajax to victory in match against Willem II (5-1)
en.summary: Ajax defeated Willem II 5-1 in a football match, with player Brandt playing a key role in the victory.

stories.title: Flink gewijzigd Ajax wint ook inhaalwedstrijd tegen Willem II met grote cijfers

en.title: Significantly changed Ajax wins rescheduled match against Willem II by large margin
en.summary: Ajax won a rescheduled Eredivisie match against Willem II 5-1 on Tuesday despite giving several players rest time.

stories.title: Naam van Trump mag niet terug op gevel van Kennedy Center, oordeelt rechter

en.title: Judge rules Trump's name cannot return to Kennedy Center façade
en.summary: A judge determined that Trump's name will not be reinstated on the Kennedy Center building.

stories.title: Nog eens tientallen arrestaties bij demonstraties tegen anti-lhbti+-operatie door Turkse regering

en.title: Dozens more arrested at demonstrations against anti-LGBTQ+ operation by Turkish government
en.summary: Turkish authorities have made additional arrests during protests against an anti-LGBTQ+ operation. These arrests follow a major government operation from the previous weekend that also included numerous detentions and social media account blockages.

stories.title: Stadionverbod voor achttien FC Utrecht-fans die met vuurwerk en bekers gooiden

en.title: Stadium ban for eighteen FC Utrecht fans who threw fireworks and cups
en.summary: Eighteen supporters of FC Utrecht have received stadium bans following an incident involving the throwing of fireworks and cups.

stories.title: Russisch oorlogsschip vuurt lichtkogels af op Deense helikopter, Navo-straaljagers halen drone neer boven Litouwen

en.title: Russian warship fires flares at Danish helicopter, NATO fighters shoot down drone over Lithuania
en.summary: A Russian military vessel discharged flares near a Danish helicopter while NATO fighter jets shot down a drone over Lithuanian airspace.

stories.title: OM onderzoekt politieoptreden na dood van Alfredo Goeloe: wat weten we tot nu toe?

en.title: Public Prosecutor investigates police conduct following death of Alfredo Goeloe: what do we know so far?
en.summary: The Public Prosecutor's Office is investigating police actions related to the death of Alfredo Goeloe.
